name: National Care Home Finder
start:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT="$(pwd)"
if [[ ! -f "$ROOT/package.json" && -f "$ROOT/repos/national-care-home-finder/package.json" ]]; then
  ROOT="$ROOT/repos/national-care-home-finder"
fi
cd "$ROOT"
export NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL="${NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL:-https://ci.invalid}"
export NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY="${NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY:-ci-placeholder-not-a-credential}"
if curl -sf -o /dev/null --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:3000/; then
  echo "Next.js dev server is already responding on port 3000"
  exit 0
fi
exec npm run dev -- --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port 3000
